notes.title: New Fighting Fantasy Classics 25% OFF!
notes.content:
TRIAL OF CHAMPIONS has arrived! The sequel to [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] joins a stellar roster of fantasy adventures in [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] - the ultimate library of text-based role playing games. And to celebrate, it's 25% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]Check it out here.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/a6d64fdadb1fcc1c90a0c798cac92a41bbce8ed9.png[/img]

[i]Trial of Champions[/i] sees you delve into the dread corridors of Baron Sukumvit’s terrible challenge for a second stab at glory. But beware! The Trial will be even more devilishly difficult this time as you begin your adventure having been captured and sold into slavery! With nothing to prepare you for this arduous adventure but your SKILL, LUCK and STAMINA, you must explore the deadly labyrinth beneath Fang. For only by triumphing in the Trial can you win back your freedom from Baron Sukumvit’s evil brother – Lord Carnuss.

Will it be enough?!

Find out for yourself and pick up this classic title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]while it's just 2.99 USD.[/url]

Also joining the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] shelf is another old favourite – Steve Jackson’s [i]House of Hell[/i]. We’ve remastered this title for the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, so it can take its rightful place amongst your collection. It is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897180/House_of_Hell_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]also 25% OFF[/url] for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/2e02525bf6cbcfc88d0dbeb0a2e7103be93af2fc.png[/img]

[i]House of Hell’s[/i] addition to the library comes with a handful of updates including:
[list]
[*] Adventure Sheet now includes 'Fear' mechanic. 
[*] Knowledge Sheet to track the clues you discover.
[*] Tim Sell’s original artwork, as well as coloured editions of each piece.
[*] [i]Haunted Hallways[/i] ambient track added.
[*] Achievements added for both [i]Trial of Champions[/i] and [i]House of Hell[/i].
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/aaf8f602b920bdc08fb7f9df81eeeee1bd82499c.png[/img]

Whether you're heading into the depths of the labyrinth beneath the city of Fang, or braving the haunted halls of the House of Drumer, may LUCK be with you and your STAMINA never fail!
